entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Ja'far al-Khazraji al-Sabti, better known as Sidi Bel Abbas, was a Moroccan Muslim saint. He is the patron saint of Marrakesh in the Islamic tradition and also one of the "Seven Saints" of the city. His festival was founded by al-Hasan al-Yusi at the instigation of Moulay Ismael.
